svg.aria-label: Message queue v1: producers push messages into one broker that keeps an in-memory queue and deletes each message once a consumer takes it. It is simple, but one machine caps throughput, a crash loses everything in memory, and once a message is consumed nobody else can read it again, so a second team cannot replay the stream.
